title: koredocs_update_with_expected_revision
prompts: Using KoreDocs MCP: create a koredoc in folder /Tests/UpdateTests, filename revision-check.koredoc, content: Revision check document - initial.

Using koredocs_file_update: look up that file's current revision with koredocs_file_get, then update it with content 'Revision check document - updated.' passing that current revision as expected_revision. Report success or failure and quote the new revision value returned by the tool.
